_readme: ISL grammar settings. These are ASSUMPTIONS to be confirmed with ISLRTC material or a fluent ISL signer.
wh_position: where WHAT/WHERE/WHO... go in the sentence: 'start' (matches the project diagram: WHAT YOUR NAME) or 'end'.
As far as I know many ISL descriptions put question words at the END, so test both with a signer.
time_first: move time expressions (TOMORROW, 5 PM) to the front of the clause.
unknown_other: same for unknown verbs/adjectives/adverbs. Default 'flag' (marked missing); fingerspelling is mainly for names and nouns.
past_marker / future_marker: gloss to add after the verb for past / future tense, or null for none (time words carry tense).
unknown_word: what to do with a word that has no entry in lexicon.json: 'fingerspell', 'flag' (marked missing) or 'skip'.
drop_lemmas: extra words removed entirely (no sign).
keep_prepositions: prepositions to keep as glosses (all other prepositions are removed).
